reconciliation.chat_end_state: The exhausted chat ended after specifying four-corner drag/snap and reported that corner persistence was not yet online at that moment.
reconciliation.current_repository_fact: Later durable Git history integrated Corner Anchor v1. Therefore the dead-chat statement is historical timing evidence, not the current implementation frontier.

recovered_product_decisions: The root experience can be a blank page with the Universal Control as the main global affordance.
Prometeo has one global Universal Control; historical child pages must not mount another global shell.
Do not hide duplicate shells with CSS; retire/remove their ability to mount global UI.
Catalog pages retain their own local controls such as whiteboard/laser/calendar tools but zero duplicate Prometeo global navigation.
Favorites belong inside the Universal Control: Favoritos, Explorar, pin/unpin current page and fullscreen Organizar páginas.
Favorites use stable page identity rather than physical tree position so organization can change without invalidating the favorite.
The selected corner is a semantic preference, not a stored pixel coordinate.
Bottom-right is the reference physical behavior; other corners mirror the same physical/navigation engine rather than cloning four state machines.
The same corner transformation applies to geometry and directional input while readable text/icons remain upright.
A short click on the closed puck opens normally; a drag over threshold owns the pointer and must never accidentally open.
Snap chooses the nearest real corner anchor, respects safe areas/viewport changes and produces one semantic event with one animation.
Moving the control during recording must not interrupt recording/transcription.
Enter/Escape semantics remain invariant across corners.
recovered_deployment_negative_knowledge: A truncated base64 V5 payload caused `String contains an invalid character`; publication must validate exact concatenated length, gzip and SHA before serving.
An old publisher removed V5 chunk files from gh-pages and caused chunk HTTP 404; index + chunks + compatibility stub must be published atomically.
Per-page imports of prometeo-shell/v2 caused duplicate buttons; the old shell must remain a retired compatibility stub.
A change is not complete merely because a local candidate HTML exists; live served bytes must be verified.
Do not infer that the chat's final observed state is the current state when later commits exist.

improve_without_visible_rewrite: Move backend responsibilities behind narrow compatibility APIs instead of continuing to grow one monolithic payload.
Make backend/degraded mode explicit internally instead of silently changing authority through catch-all fallback implementations.
Move persistence ownership out of the UI coordinator only after shadow parity and rollback-safe migration.
Replace full-note resync scans over time with durable mutation/outbox/receipt semantics under the Capture owner.
Let Navigation state own semantic route/page state while URL, selector and iframe become projections rather than mutually coupled authorities.
Keep Context/Patent and identity/device mechanics behind their existing owners rather than making the shell a second authority.

monotonic_migration_rule: Freeze current served V5 as Golden Master; add compatibility facade with exact old behavior; test parity; wire candidate only; run browser/reload/offline parity; then shadow a proposed backend; cut over one domain only after verification; keep rollback; promote served only when no proven baseline capability is lost.
next_frontier: Wire the Favorites compatibility facade into a candidate-only materialized V5 payload using the exact current localStorage key and synchronous semantics; compare legacy/facade behavior in-browser and across reload/offline cases. Do not touch Served until parity passes.
